verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents generating interactive API reference pages from OpenAPI specs with request builders, endpoint pages and navigation (mintlify-docs-14), which supports the 'runnable examples' aspect of API docs. However, there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming the interactivity actually executes requests (no probe confirming live API playground functionality), and the story's AI-native framing (agentic exploration) is not directly evidenced beyond generic AI assistant/chat features. missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification that the API playground is runnable end-to-end, explicit connection between API reference interactivity and AI-agent-driven exploration.
